system_boundary.input: registered business scope, field definitions, rules and options
system_boundary.actuator: future public API and dynamic form/list consumers
system_boundary.sensor: revision status, typed value indexes, audit records and schema checks
system_boundary.external_boundary: existing dictionary, organization, user, role, attachment and permission contracts

invariants: tenant_id is present on every table
field_key is stable within a scope and labels are not identifiers
core business data remains in business tables
value columns match the declared value_type
client field names never become SQL identifiers
published configuration is snapshotable and rollbackable
disturbances: deleted field definition referenced by old values
control_actions: query only indexed and configured fields
